description: Build complete UI component library and layout system. Create all reusable components in components/ui/ (Button, Input, Select, Textarea, Badge, Card, Modal, Skeleton, Spinner, Toast, Avatar, Breadcrumb, Pagination, EmptyState, ErrorBoundary) following exact design system specs (48px input height, 8px border-radius, primary green buttons, shadow levels). Build layout components (Header with logo/nav/search/cart icon/user menu, Footer with links/copyright, Sidebar for marketplace filters). Set up Zustand stores (auth.store.ts for user/token/login/logout, cart.store.ts for items/add/remove/sync, ui.store.ts for toasts/modals/loading). Create API endpoint wrappers in lib/api/endpoints.ts for all backend routes. Create middleware.ts for Next.js route protection.
steps: Create frontend/components/ui/Button.tsx: variants (primary bg-primary text-white, secondary border-2 border-primary text-primary, text transparent underline-on-hover), sizes (default h-12 desktop h-11, sm h-10, lg h-14), rounded-lg, font-semibold, disabled:opacity-50, hover:darken-10%

Create frontend/components/ui/Input.tsx: h-12, px-4, border border-border rounded-lg, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary, error state with border-error, label (text-sm font-medium text-textSecondary), helperText (text-xs text-textSecondary), errorText (text-xs text-error)
Create frontend/components/ui/Select.tsx, Textarea.tsx following same pattern as Input

Create frontend/components/ui/Badge.tsx: variants (default bg-primary text-white, secondary bg-secondary, accent bg-accent text-textPrimary, success bg-success, warning bg-warning, error bg-error), sizes (sm px-2 py-0.5 text-xs, md px-3 py-1 text-sm), rounded-md
Create frontend/components/ui/Card.tsx: bg-surface border border-border rounded-xl p-4 md:p-6, shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow
Create frontend/components/ui/Modal.tsx: fixed inset-0 z-50, backdrop bg-black/50, content max-w-lg mx-auto mt-20 bg-surface rounded-xl p-6, close button top-right

Create frontend/components/ui/Skeleton.tsx, Spinner.tsx, Toast.tsx (notification system with Zustand), Avatar.tsx (circular image with fallback initials), Breadcrumb.tsx, Pagination.tsx (prev/next + page numbers), EmptyState.tsx (icon + message + optional CTA), ErrorBoundary.tsx (class component catching errors)

Create frontend/components/layout/Header.tsx: sticky top-0 bg-surface border-b, container with logo (link to /), nav links (Marketplace, Categories), search bar (icon + input + category dropdown), cart icon with count badge (from cart store), user menu dropdown (authenticated: Dashboard/Orders/Settings/Logout, unauthenticated: Login/Register)
Create frontend/components/layout/Footer.tsx: bg-primary text-white, 4 columns (About, Categories, Support, Contact), social icons, copyright '© 2024 AgriMarket. Built for Ethiopian farmers.'
Create frontend/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx: filters panel for marketplace (Categories checkboxes, Price range slider, Region select, Rating filter, In Stock toggle), Apply/Clear buttons

Create frontend/lib/store/auth.store.ts: Zustand store with state (user: User|null, token: string|null, isAuthenticated: boolean), actions (login(token, user) - save to localStorage, logout() - clear localStorage + redirect, hydrate() - read from localStorage on mount, updateUser(user))

Create frontend/lib/store/cart.store.ts: state (items: CartItem[], isLoading: boolean, error: string|null), actions (addItem(productId, quantity), updateItem(itemId, quantity), removeItem(itemId), clearCart(), syncWithBackend() - fetch from GET /cart and update state, validateCart() - call GET /cart/validate)

Create frontend/lib/store/ui.store.ts: state (toasts: Toast[], modals: Modal[], isLoading: boolean), actions (showToast(message, severity), hideToast(id), openModal(id, content), closeModal(id), setLoading(isLoading))

Create frontend/lib/api/endpoints.ts: export const authApi = { login: (email, password) => axiosClient.post('/auth/login', {email, password}), register: (data) => axiosClient.post('/auth/register', data), getMe: () => axiosClient.get('/auth/me'), logout: () => axiosClient.post('/auth/logout') }, productApi = { list: (params) => axiosClient.get('/products', {params}), getBySlug: (slug) => axiosClient.get(`/products/slug/${slug}`), getById: (id) => axiosClient.get(`/products/${id}`) }, cartApi = { get: () => axiosClient.get('/cart'), add: (productId, quantity) => axiosClient.post('/cart/items', {productId, quantity}), update: (itemId, quantity) => axiosClient.patch(`/cart/items/${itemId}`, {quantity}), remove: (itemId) => axiosClient.delete(`/cart/items/${itemId}`) }, orderApi, categoryApi, addressApi, checkoutApi, wishlistApi, notificationApi - all matching backend routes

Create frontend/middleware.ts: export middleware function that checks for token in cookies/localStorage for protected routes (/dashboard*, /checkout, /orders*), redirect to /auth/login if unauthenticated, allow public routes (/, /marketplace, /products/*, /auth/*)
acceptance_criteria: All 14 UI components render correctly with design system styling (primary green #166534, 48px inputs, 8px radius, Inter font)
Header displays logo, nav, search bar, cart icon with count from Zustand store, user menu dropdown
Footer has 4 columns with links and copyright text
Sidebar renders filter controls (will wire up to marketplace in next feature)
Zustand stores export correct types and actions: authStore.login(), cartStore.addItem(), uiStore.showToast()
lib/api/endpoints.ts has typed wrappers for auth, product, cart, order, category, address, checkout, wishlist, notification APIs
middleware.ts protects /dashboard and /checkout routes (redirects to /auth/login if no token)
verification: npm run dev, navigate to http://localhost:3000

Manually import and render each UI component on a test page to verify styling: Button variants, Input with label/error, Badge colors, Card with shadow, Modal open/close, Skeleton animations, Spinner, Toast notifications, Avatar with initials, Breadcrumb, Pagination, EmptyState, ErrorBoundary
Create test page that imports Header, Footer, Sidebar and verifies they render with correct structure
Test Zustand stores in browser console: import useAuthStore; useAuthStore.getState().login('test-token', {user data}); verify localStorage.getItem('accessToken') === 'test-token'
Test API client: import {authApi} from lib/api/endpoints; await authApi.getMe() (should send GET to http://localhost:3001/api/v1/auth/me with Authorization header)
Test middleware: create protected route /dashboard/test, navigate without token -> should redirect to /auth/login
